hints.title: Sorted Strong Pair Window
hints.text: Sort the numbers. For x <= y, the strong pair condition |x - y| <= min(x, y) simplifies to y <= 2 * x.

hints.title: Sliding Window Elements
hints.text: As the right pointer r advances, maintain a window [l, r] such that nums[r] <= 2 * nums[l]. When invalid, increment l.

hints.title: Bitwise Prefix Structure
hints.text: Maintain numbers in the current window within a bitwise prefix trie with count references to query the maximum bitwise xor.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting followed by 20-bit trie insertions and queries across sliding window.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combine two-pointer windowing with bitwise prefix trie to maintain active elements.
